claim_limits: The study does not identify the physiological origin of any object.
The annotators' breath marks are a comparison series, not a ground truth.
Nothing here estimates respiratory rate for clinical use.
intake.data_source: PhysioNet BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset, version 1.0.0, DOI 10.13026/C2208R; the RESP column of bidmc_NN_Signals.csv for subjects 1 to 53 at 125 Hz, 60,001 samples each.
measurements: Count of complete objects per subject
Peak position of each object in samples
Period between consecutive peaks in seconds
Full excursion of the raw signal within the object
Temporal symmetry of rise and fall durations
intake.object_definition: One row of the result is one trough-to-trough respiratory object: a rising occurrence together with the falling occurrence that follows it, with the peak at the last rising sample.

preprocessing_steps.step: Compute respiration_smooth as the rolling maximum of respiration over smooth_window samples, then the rolling mean over smooth_window samples, shifted back by smooth_window samples to produce a look‑ahead envelope.
Compute respiration_change as the first difference of respiration_smooth.

provenance: Contract fingerprint (SHA‑256 of the canonical contract JSON)
Featuregraph version, Python, numpy, pandas, and scipy versions
Git commit and clean tree status
intake.research_question: Does a rolling-envelope construction of the BIDMC impedance respiration signal, declared once and frozen, produce respiratory rising and falling occurrences whose peaks agree with the two annotators' breath marks across all 53 subjects, and if not, where does it disagree?
intake.time_semantics: Each row represents an instant sample; consecutive rows are spaced 8 ms apart.
intake.title: BIDMC respiratory objects at a fixed envelope scale

validations.description: Rows where respiration_smooth or respiration_change is undefined at the edges of a subject's record are excluded and counted in the validation report.
validations.name: edge_exclusions_reported
